program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs')

program_path=program_dir/'task-1499e2ef.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Fill single-cell gaps between matching marks in horizontal rows."""
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(len(row) - 2):
            if row[c] != background and row[c] == row[c + 2] and row[c + 1] == background:
                out[r][c + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
